provenance.reason: The original repository was deleted after the June 2026 incident. This fixture preserves the last locally observed original-repository snapshot so the fixed T-1 case is not silently dropped or replaced with incomplete mirror data.
provenance.historical_boundary: Git-derived factors are filtered to the 2026-06-07 cutoff. Original-repository API metadata, including the 29-public-member organization proxy, was observed on 2026-06-10 and is not represented as a direct T-1 observation.

archive_corroboration.note: All 517 commit hashes in the public archive occur in this fixture; the archive omits 16 later commits and cannot replace the observed snapshot.
